english.title: Keeper fail to notify the Welsh National Assembly within 3 days of the movement of cattle on / off a holding in Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a keeper of cattle failed to notify the Welsh National Assembly within three days of a movement of such

(A)_[an animal]_
(B)_[animals]_

(C)_[on to]_
(D)_[off]_

a holding located at **(.. SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE HOLDING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 15 of, and paragraph 1 of Schedule 4 to the Cattle Identification (Wales) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
